tool_name.description: The name of the tool to be created

tool_description.description: A brief description of the tool's functionality

tool_type.description: The type/category of the tool (e.g., 'utility', 'analysis', 'automation') comma separated if multiple types apply

tool_dependencies.description: A list of dependencies required for the tool to function properly

groupId.description: The group ID of the dependency (e.g., 'com.example')

artifactId.description: The artifact ID of the dependency (e.g., 'example-library')

version.description: The version of the dependency (e.g., '1.0.0'), if it is not a spring boot dependency
